title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #1

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Who took care of the Prophet after his mother died and his grandfather passed on? (1 mark)
   A. Waraqa
   B. His uncle Abu Talib
   C. Abu Bakr
   D. Ali as a baby

2. A friend gives you back too much change by mistake. What would a person of the Prophet's character do? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it quietly
   B. Return the extra money
   C. Tell others to do the same
   D. Spend it on sweets

3. Which hand should a Muslim use for eating? (1 mark)
   A. Left hand
   B. No hand, use a fork only
   C. Right hand
   D. Either hand equally

4. How much toothpaste should a child use? (1 mark)
   A. A full tube
   B. A pea-sized amount
   C. None
   D. A whole handful

5. How often should a toothbrush be replaced? (1 mark)
   A. Every ten years
   B. About every three months or when bristles bend
   C. Never
   D. Every day

6. In which sport is Kenya most famous for its athletes? (1 mark)
   A. Long-distance running
   B. Swimming
   C. Cycling
   D. Gymnastics

7. What is fair play? (1 mark)
   A. Insulting opponents
   B. Keeping the rules and not cheating
   C. Winning at all costs
   D. Ignoring the referee

8. Which of these is a mistake about Allah's names? (1 mark)
   A. Thinking Allah is like a human being
   B. Teaching them
   C. Learning them
   D. Using them in dua

9. When the Qur'an (20:46) says Allah is with Musa and Harun "hearing and seeing", which names are shown? (1 mark)
   A. Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim
   B. Ar-Rahim and As-Salam
   C. As-Sami' and Al-Basir
   D. Al-Malik and As-Salam

10. How many pillars of Iman are there? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Seven
   C. Ten
   D. Five

11. Belief in angels is one of the pillars of (1 mark)
   A. Hajj
   B. Zakat
   C. Islam only
   D. Iman

12. Which two prophets showed obedience when Ibrahim was told in a dream to sacrifice? (1 mark)
   A. Ibrahim and Ismail
   B. Nuh and Hud
   C. Yusuf and Yaqub
   D. Musa and Harun

13. How should we treat dogs? (1 mark)
   A. Cruelly
   B. Hit them
   C. Ignore hunger
   D. Kindly, but avoid their saliva

14. A baby girl's urine falls on a mat. What type of najasa is it? (1 mark)
   A. Medium
   B. Light
   C. Not a najasa
   D. Heavy

15. Which body part is wiped, not washed? (1 mark)
   A. Head
   B. Arms
   C. Face
   D. Hands

16. Which of these shows waste in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving the tap running
   B. Closing the tap
   C. Using a small jug
   D. Saving water

17. How far are the feet washed? (1 mark)
   A. Up to and including the ankles
   B. Knees
   C. Toes only
   D. Heels only

18. How many rak'ahs does Dhuhr have? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Two
   C. Five
   D. Three

19. Which of these can help find the Qibla? (1 mark)
   A. A compass or Qibla app
   B. The noise from the road
   C. The colour of the sky
   D. The size of the mosque

20. Which prayer is right after sunset? (1 mark)
   A. Asr
   B. Dhuhr
   C. Maghrib
   D. Fajr

21. How many rak'ahs does Isha have? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. Five
   C. Four
   D. Three

22. How can we help birds in the dry season? (1 mark)
   A. Trap them
   B. Put out water in a dish
   C. Throw stones
   D. Break nests

23. What is "rahmah"? (1 mark)
   A. Anger
   B. Pride
   C. Mercy
   D. Fear

24. What did the Prophet say about modesty? (1 mark)
   A. It is a game
   B. It is part of faith
   C. It is only for girls
   D. It is weakness

25. Which of these should you never share with strangers? (1 mark)
   A. Your favourite food
   B. Your favourite colour
   C. The weather
   D. Your passwords

26. Which is a positive use of media? (1 mark)
   A. Learning a surah with a recording
   B. Watching harmful content
   C. Bullying online
   D. Sharing rumours

27. What is "income"? (1 mark)
   A. Debt
   B. A gift
   C. A prayer
   D. Money earned from work

28. Which is a way a child can earn safely with permission? (1 mark)
   A. Taking loans
   B. Stealing
   C. Begging on the road
   D. Doing chores for a small reward

29. What did the Prophet say about the upper hand? (1 mark)
   A. It does not matter
   B. It is better than the lower hand
   C. They are equal
   D. It is worse

30. What is begging? (1 mark)
   A. Farming
   B. Saving
   C. Asking for money or things without real need
   D. Working

31. Which is an obligation of parents? (1 mark)
   A. Neglecting health
   B. Providing food, clothing and shelter
   C. Making them work all day
   D. Ignoring children

32. Which is a good reply to a parent's call? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting
   B. "Yes, Mama, I am coming."
   C. Silence
   D. "Leave me alone."

33. What does "lower the wing of humility" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Ignore them
   C. Fly
   D. Be gentle and humble to them

34. What should a child do to a cousin who has more toys? (1 mark)
   A. Break them
   B. Take them
   C. Be happy for them, not envy
   D. Envy them

35. In which month did the first revelation come? (1 mark)
   A. Shawwal
   B. Rajab
   C. Ramadan
   D. Muharram

36. Which qualities of the Prophet did Khadija mention? (1 mark)
   A. He is rude
   B. He keeps ties, helps the weak and honours guests
   C. He is careless
   D. He is lazy

37. What was the first word revealed? (1 mark)
   A. Pray
   B. Fast
   C. Give
   D. Iqra (Read)

38. Who was the first Caliph? (1 mark)
   A. Ali
   B. Uthman
   C. Abu Bakr
   D. Umar

39. What was Khadija's job? (1 mark)
   A. Teacher
   B. Soldier
   C. Farmer
   D. Businesswoman

40. What did the Prophet do in the garden? (1 mark)
   A. Fled to another land
   B. Made dua to Allah
   C. Ate everything
   D. Cursed them

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Give two items used in purification of najasaat. (2 marks)

42. Describe what happened when Jibril came to the Prophet in the cave. (3 marks)

43. What do we say in ruku, in sujud and when sitting between the two sujud? (3 marks)

44. Explain why wudhu is important in the life of a Muslim. (4 marks)

45. State three duties to grandparents. (3 marks)

46. List the first four pillars of swalah. (4 marks)

47. Why is Laylat al-Qadr connected to the first revelation? (3 marks)

48. Describe how to clean a place licked by a dog. (3 marks)

49. What are angels created from, and what do they never do? (2 marks)

50. Describe what happened to Taif in later years. (3 marks)

51. State four obligations of parents to their children. (4 marks)

52. Draw or describe a simple family chart showing at least five relatives and their Kiswahili names. (5 marks)

53. Explain why the earliest converts are important. (3 marks)

54. What lesson do we learn from Surah Al-Masad? (3 marks)

55. When must a child not obey a parent, and how should the child still behave? (3 marks)

56. Name three types of Muslim clothing worn in Kenya. (3 marks)

57. Describe how Ali (R.A.) accepted Islam and what he did as a young man. (3 marks)

58. Explain how belief in Raqib and Atid helps a child behave well. (3 marks)

59. Describe how to show patience to an elderly parent or grandparent. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — His uncle Abu Talib
   Abu Talib cared for him as a young boy.

2. B — Return the extra money
   Honesty means returning what is not yours.

3. C — Right hand
   The Prophet taught eating with the right.

4. B — A pea-sized amount
   A small amount is enough.

5. B — About every three months or when bristles bend
   Worn bristles do not clean well.

6. A — Long-distance running
   Kenya is known for its long-distance runners.

7. B — Keeping the rules and not cheating
   Fair play means honesty in sport.

8. A — Thinking Allah is like a human being
   Nothing is like Allah.

9. C — As-Sami' and Al-Basir
   Allah hears and sees.

10. A — Six
   There are six pillars of Iman.

11. D — Iman
   The six pillars of Iman include angels.

12. A — Ibrahim and Ismail
   Both were ready to obey Allah.

13. D — Kindly, but avoid their saliva
   Islam teaches kindness to animals.

14. A — Medium
   Baby girl's urine is washed as medium najasa in this teaching.

15. A — Head
   The head is wiped.

16. A — Leaving the tap running
   Islam teaches us not to waste water.

17. A — Up to and including the ankles
   To the ankles.

18. A — Four
   Dhuhr has four.

19. A — A compass or Qibla app
   A compass helps find north.

20. C — Maghrib
   Maghrib is after sunset.

21. C — Four
   Isha has four.

22. B — Put out water in a dish
   Birds need water.

23. C — Mercy
   Rahmah means mercy.

24. B — It is part of faith
   Recorded by Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

25. D — Your passwords
   Passwords keep you safe.

26. A — Learning a surah with a recording
   Media can teach.

27. D — Money earned from work
   Income is what we earn.

28. D — Doing chores for a small reward
   With parents' permission.

29. B — It is better than the lower hand
   The giver is better than the receiver.

30. C — Asking for money or things without real need
   Begging is asking without need.

31. B — Providing food, clothing and shelter
   Basic needs.

32. B — "Yes, Mama, I am coming."
   Politeness.

33. D — Be gentle and humble to them
   Be humble.

34. C — Be happy for them, not envy
   Do not envy.

35. C — Ramadan
   The Qur'an began in Ramadan.

36. B — He keeps ties, helps the weak and honours guests
   She praised his character.

37. D — Iqra (Read)
   Iqra means read.

38. C — Abu Bakr
   Abu Bakr led the Muslims after the Prophet.

39. D — Businesswoman
   She was a respected trader.

40. B — Made dua to Allah
   He turned to Allah.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Water, soil, soap, clean cloth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jibril told him to read, he said he could not read, Jibril pressed him and repeated three times, then recited the first verses.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for reply, 1 mark for three times and recitation.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ruku: Subhana Rabbiyal Azim; sujud: Subhana Rabbiyal A'la; sitting: Rabbighfir li.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: It is required for prayer; it cleans and refreshes; it brings reward; it prepares the heart for meeting Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Respect and greet them, help them, visit them, listen to their stories, make dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Niyyah, qiyam, takbiratul ihram, and reciting Al-Fatiha.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Qur'an says it was sent down on the Night of Power in Ramadan, which is why Ramadan is special.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Night of Power, 1 mark for Ramadan, 1 mark for the Qur'an.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash seven times with water, one washing being mixed with clean soil, then rinse and dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for seven washings, 1 mark for soil once, 1 mark for rinsing.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: They are created from light and they never disobey Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: In later years its people accepted Islam, and many descendants of those who rejected the Prophet became Muslims.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: Food, clothing and shelter; health care; education; a good name; teaching faith; love; protection.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

52. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: babu, bibi, baba, shangazi, mjomba, binamu, each placed correctly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct relative up to 5.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: They believed when it was hard, supported the Prophet morally and materially, and encouraged others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wealth and family connections cannot save a person who refuses the truth and harms good people. We should avoid pride and harm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for wealth cannot save, 1 mark for harming others is wrong, 1 mark for avoiding pride.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: When a parent commands something Allah forbids. The child should still treat them kindly and politely.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the case, 1 mark for not obeying, 1 mark for kindness.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kanzu, kofia, hijab or headscarf, buibui, long dress.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: He saw the Prophet and Khadija praying, asked, and accepted Islam. He was loyal and brave and slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the migration.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words and actions are recorded, so the child speaks the truth, avoids wrong and does good, and repents when wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for recorded deeds, 1 mark for good behaviour, 1 mark for repentance.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen without complaining, help them to walk and eat, speak gently.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
